text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Small... Small... I'm so incredibly small!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I'm still gonna... GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... I won... but I don't feel proud at
all... I just
feel... pathetic. And
frustrated...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer's expression is bitter and
miserable
the whole race through, but
she runs with all her
might and wins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen... And Ryan too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Congrats. You ran very, uh, persistently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This was something I've always wanted
to
accomplish for myself. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As another Mejiro has accomplished it in
my
stead, I suppose my frustrations are
somewhat
eased.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing for you to apologize
for. You
confidently demonstrated your
abilities today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being me. And I'm sorry for
not being
able to be the real me. I
dunno how to put it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run more like me! I wanted
everyone
to think, "That's Mejiro
Palmer!" Everyone else
was able to be
themselves, but me! I'm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm just... so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What was that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I don't really understand either...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She may seem easygoing, but she can
get like this
at times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's very complicated and may be quite

sensitive. But she doesn't seem to know
herself
well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Palmster? C'mon,
cheer up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Mejiro Palmer doesn't manage to
crack a
smile for the rest of the evening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I feel so small and so... insignificant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer looks up at the ceiling
and lets out
a soft sigh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be tied down by the
Mejiro name,
so I thought I'd show more
of my real self...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But when I saw how serious McQueen
was, I didn't
know what else there even
was to run for besides
the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd run for my own freedom,
but... what's
that freedom even for? For
sating my own selfish
desires? Or is it for
something else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what it is, but is that reasoning
something
I can really be proud of in
front of McQueen? Can
it even be
compared to her own determination?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because it was the spring Tenno Sho, which is just so important to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But I wanna get back to my real self,
even just a
little... So for my next race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She trails off gloomily. A festival race
might the
best thing to pick her mood
up. In which case...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's enter the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios blurts out the race name,

sounding energetic yet mournful.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be, like, so fire to run
together?! It'll
be like this never
happened. We can just bring
the vibes,
bestie-style!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's a festival race! Everyone's there
to get
pumped and have a good time
anyway! So, like,
you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... The Takarazuka Kinen could be
good...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives a slight nod. But...
choice_data_list: いいと思う。そこにしよう
choice_data_list_en: Sounds good. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen, we need
to take
another look at what racing
means to Mejiro
Palmer.
